categories.main_business_segments: Whan In Pharm Co., Ltd. primarily operates in pharmaceutical manufacturing and sales, focusing on central nervous system (CNS) drugs, especially psychiatric and neurological medications which account for over 80% of sales. The company also engages in medical device manufacturing and real estate leasing, with subsidiaries involved in pharmaceutical R&D and distribution.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies with production facilities in Anseong and Hyangnam, operating under KGMP standards. It emphasizes chemical synthesis for new drug development, including CNS drugs, and employs proprietary formulation technologies such as sustained-release microspheres and tablet formulation improvements. R&D is conducted through centralized research institutes with expertise in drug discovery and development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies within South Korea, with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of revenue. The main market is the domestic pharmaceutical market, particularly CNS therapeutic areas such as schizophrenia, epilepsy, and depression. The company also has exclusive domestic distribution agreements for several imported drugs from global pharmaceutical firms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and sales are predominantly domestic within South Korea. It imports raw materials and finished products from countries including France, Portugal, the United States, and Hungary for exclusive domestic distribution. Export sales exist but are minimal compared to domestic sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Whan In Pharm operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, including drug manufacturing, formulation, and distribution. It sources raw materials both domestically and internationally and sells finished pharmaceutical products directly to healthcare providers and through wholesalers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on CNS drug development, including new chemical entities and improved formulations, with ongoing clinical trials for schizophrenia, Parkinson’s disease, Alzheimer’s, and other neurological disorders. The company invests heavily in R&D, maintaining a dedicated research organization with 82 staff, and pursues partnerships and licensing agreements to expand its product pipeline and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of pharmaceutical products, including proprietary drugs and licensed imported products, to hospitals and wholesalers. The company operates on a credit sales basis with payment terms of 1 to 6 months. Licensing-in and exclusive distribution agreements contribute to product portfolio expansion but no licensing-out revenue is reported.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Whan In Pharm holds the number one market share in the domestic psychiatric drug market and competes with major Korean pharmaceutical companies such as Yuhan Corporation, Green Cross, Daewoong Pharmaceutical, Hanmi Pharmaceutical, and others. The company leverages strong sales capabilities and exclusive distribution contracts to maintain a competitive position in CNS therapeutics.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 230.4 billion, representing a 15.8% year-over-year increase, with operating profit of KRW 30.2 billion and net profit of KRW 29.8 billion, both showing growth. Total assets reached KRW 401.2 billion, up 8.6%, with a low debt ratio of about 12%, indicating solid financial health and steady growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Whan In Pharm differentiates itself through its leadership in CNS pharmaceuticals, strong R&D capabilities focused on innovative psychiatric and neurological treatments, and exclusive domestic distribution rights for key imported drugs. The company emphasizes high-quality manufacturing, strategic partnerships, and a robust sales network to deliver superior therapeutic options and maintain market leadership.
